params.prompt: Photorealistic restaurant menu food photograph, 3/4 angle from slightly above. Loaded fries in a paper food tray lined with green-and-white checkered paper: a generous pile of golden, crisp french fries topped with chopped grilled carne asada, melted cheddar cheese, a scoop of chunky guacamole, fresh pico de gallo, and drizzles of orange chipotle aioli and sour cream. The food sits on the red-painted wooden counter of a walk-up food stand in Los Angeles. Bright natural afternoon sunlight with crisp soft shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field; background softly blurred warm red and brick tones with a hint of colorful cut-paper banners. Tack-sharp focus, true-to-life textures and natural color, appetizing, real street-food look, not over-styled. No text, no logos, no labels, no people, no hands.
